about: Coding agents a player could ask to set up a model on their own machine (src/logic/intelligence/LocalSetup.ts writes the prompt). Read on each vendor's own page on 2026-11-04; terms change often, so each row says when. Free and needing no account first. Which to show is Pedro's pick.

agents.name: Aider
agents.local: yes; raise num_ctx past Ollama's small default

agents.name: Continue
agents.local: yes; agent mode needs a model with tool support

agents.name: GitHub Copilot Free
agents.free: yes: agent mode, the CLI, 2,000 completions a month
agents.local: bring-your-own-key, including locally hosted models (Ollama not named)

agents.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
agents.free: Codex is listed on ChatGPT's Free plan; its limits are not published, and the CLI is not named for Free
agents.account: a ChatGPT account for the plan
agents.local: yes, codex --oss with the ollama provider

agents.name: Antigravity CLI
agents.free: an Individuals plan at $0 with basic weekly limits; it replaced Gemini CLI's free tier on 2026-06-18

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.free: no: not on Claude's Free plan
agents.account: a Claude account for the plans
agents.local: Ollama documents running it on a local model; Anthropic's pages do not
